newsitem.title: FRANCE: Air China plans Paris autumn freighter.
newsitem.headline: Air China plans Paris autumn freighter.

text.p: Air China said it was planning to launch a weekly Boeing 747F service between Paris and Beijing later this year.

"October looks a likely launch date for the Paris freighter but as we speak, the airline has yet to provide official confirmation to this effect," a Paris-based cargo official for Air China told Reuters.

The official said the proposed launch of a freighter was in response to buoyant market conditions, boosting the cargo capacity already offered by Air China's twice-weekly 747 Combi and weekly 747 passenger flight on the route, the official said.
Air China operates a weekly 747F flight between Frankfurt and Beijing.
